split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate commits; position 1 is normative, position 2 is determinative
split_justification.reason: The vocabulary, validators, migration, sample method and proofs form one testable whole. The drawn sample and its independent evaluations are evidence about the fixed normative commit and may not alter the selection method they were drawn under; they land after the acceptance run, and a review finding that demands normative repair would insert a new normative position with a machine readable justification and a complete fresh run instead of amending.
condition_per_commit: the position is self contained: it introduces no reference to an artifact a later position creates, with the declared exception that determinative record files carry their own R4 bindings in position 2
